title: Constant-coefficient projection formula for etale direct image over excellent schemes
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $m\geq1$, $A=\mathbf Z/\ell^m\mathbf Z$, and $g:V\to X$ a finitely presented morphism of Noetherian excellent schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-exc-excellent-ring, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Use the ordinary small-etale derived categories and derived direct image $Rg_*$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. A complex belongs to $D^b_{ctf}$ if its cohomology is bounded and constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and there exist integers $a\leq b$ such that tensoring it with any module sheaf in degree zero has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For $L\in D^b_{ctf}(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the complex $Rg_*L$ belongs to $D^b_{ctf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. If $P$ is a bounded complex of finitely generated $A$-modules and $\underline P_X,\underline P_V$ are its termwise constant sheaf complexes [def-kun-constant-sheaf], the counit-defined projection map is an isomorphism
$$Rg_*L\otimes_A^L\underline P_X\xrightarrow{\sim}Rg_*(L\otimes_A^L\underline P_V).$$
No finite projective dimension of $P$ is assumed. In particular, for $1\leq n\leq m$ and $B=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, it gives the canonical isomorphism in $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$
$$\chi_{g,L}:(Rg_{*,A}L)\otimes_A^LB\xrightarrow{\sim}Rg_{*,B}(L\otimes_A^LB),$$
whose transpose is scalar extension of the $g_A^*\dashv Rg_{*,A}$ counit, using the inverse-image/tensor identification [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and the restriction/direct-image comparison [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons]. These maps are natural in $L$ and $P$.
